svg.aria-label: IndiGo carried 16.5M international passengers in 2025 against Air India's 10.6M, at an average international stage length of 2,669 km against Air India's 5,389 km. Air India's average international flight is 2.0 times IndiGo's.
svg.desc: Source: DGCA traffic statistics, pulled 2026-08-15. Computed in-repo, not quoted.
